attchmntText: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited has published its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors in a meeting held on 14.11.2026. The company published the results in the Financial Express and Nawan Zamana newspapers on November 15, 2026. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement includes newspaper clippings as evidence of publication. No specific financial figures or performance metrics are detailed in this text. The information is submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd for their records.

attchmntText: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Bhandari Hosiery Exports Limited approved un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations was 7,845.82 lakhs for the quarter, compared to 6,833.47 lakhs in the previous year. Profit before tax stood at 208.36 lakhs for the quarter, down from 267.70 lakhs. Net profit for the period was 163.16 lakhs, with basic earnings per share at 0.05 rupees. For the half year, revenue was 12,930.53 lakhs, and net profit was 282.81 lakhs. The company has 33,29,56,433 equity shares. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 32,794.16 lakhs. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report with an unmodified opinion.
